summary: Backend regression (18 tests) passes end-to-end against localhost:8001 - auth (login/me/logout, brute-force-safe 401), companies CRUD, employees list (admin visible), attendance today/history/stats with new {checked_in, attendance} shape, GPS active/history, tasks CRUD + stats. Previous iteration's employees 500 and attendance/today 404 are fixed. However the public preview URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) still returns Emergent's 'Preview Unavailable' HTML for '/' and 404 for '/api/*', so no user-facing frontend or integration testing was possible from outside the pod. This is the same infra blocker as iteration_1.

integration_issues.issue: Preview URL https://mahossain432-gmail-com-officeflow.preview.emergentagent.com serves Emergent's 'Preview Unavailable!!! Our Agent is resting after inactivity' page (title=Not Found). /api/* returns 404 from Cloudflare/ingress, not FastAPI. Backend is healthy on localhost:8001 but ingress is not routing this pod. Playwright cannot even see the login form.

action_items: PLATFORM: Wake the preview environment (open app.emergent.sh and restart the app) or fix the ingress so that https://mahossain432-gmail-com-officeflow.preview.emergentagent.com routes '/' to the React dev server on :3000 and '/api/*' to FastAPI on :8001. Without this, no external UI / integration testing can be performed and end users cannot use the app.

After wake-up, re-run frontend Playwright suite: login -> dashboard stat cards -> sidebar nav across 10 modules -> theme toggle persistence -> attendance check-in -> tasks kanban create/update -> logout.

Consider tightening secure/samesite cookie flags for local testing OR document that backend tests must inject cookies via Cookie header when running against http://localhost (already handled in backend_test.py).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py brute-force key is `client.host:email` - behind ingress client.host is the proxy IP so the whole tenant shares one bucket per email; acceptable but note it is per-email, not per-IP.
employees.py get_employees returns ALL users including super_admin as an 'employee' (no role filter). This is why the admin appears in the employees table; probably intentional but worth confirming.
attendance.py check-in stores check_in as ISO string but created_at as datetime - inconsistent. Response conversion handles both, but be careful when adding new fields.

auth.py login sets cookies with secure=True + samesite=none unconditionally; correct for prod HTTPS but means cookies are dropped by any HTTP client on non-TLS (must inject Cookie header for local tests).

tasks.py create_task uses **task.model_dump() which will silently include any client-supplied field defined on TaskCreate; ensure TaskCreate doesn't expose privileged fields (e.g. created_by, progress).
gps.py update_location sums distance without a time/accuracy sanity check; a bad GPS jump will inflate total_distance. Non-blocking but worth a filter.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green on localhost:8001. The blocker is the preview ingress at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL - it shows Emergent's asleep-agent page and /api/* returns 404 (Cloudflare, not FastAPI). Once the preview is woken from app.emergent.sh, run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (the TestPublicIngress class will start passing) and then run Playwright against the public URL to cover all 14 frontend flows in the review request. Pytest ini requires -n 0 to disable xdist for serial run. Cookies must be injected via Cookie header when hitting http://localhost because they are Secure+SameSite=None (already handled in the fixture).
rca of the issue: Preview URL 404 root cause: Emergent's edge (Cloudflare) is serving a static 'Preview Unavailable' Webflow page for this hostname because the app has been marked as inactive. The Kubernetes pod running frontend:3000 and backend:8001 is healthy and answering on localhost, but the ingress that would normally forward / -> :3000 and /api -> :8001 has been detached. Fix: user restarts the app from app.emergent.sh; no code change required.
